description: Find New York open data portals and sources (state, county, city, agency, library, nonprofit) in BetaNYC's registry by topic, name or place. Returns each source's portal URL, platform family, API type, dataset count, status and last-verified date. Searches portal names and notes, not dataset titles (use search_datasets for datasets). Default status filter is 'live'.

has_api.description: Only sources with (true) or without (false) a queryable API

place.description: County, city, NYC borough or region, e.g. 'Erie County', 'Buffalo', 'Brooklyn', 'Capital Region'

status.description: Default 'live'. Use 'any' to include no-portal, dead and UNCONFIRMED rows

tier.description: 1 statewide portals, 2 state agencies/authorities, 3 local government, 4 nonprofit/academic

name: find_sources
